items.statement: Expects 15% volume growth for FY25
items.quote: Volume growth as there is no inflation the volume growth what we are expecting is somewhere around 15% we can expect.

items.statement: Expects 15% topline growth and 1-1.5% bottom-line increase for FY25
items.quote: The topline growth of 15% and on the bottom-line one to one and half percent increase is possible

items.statement: Expects margin improvement of around 150 basis points
items.quote: We can expect 150 basis points we can expect but uh actually the base is now set actually the capacity utilization is also brighter in all divisions

items.statement: Ice-cream and curd demand expected to be strong in summer season starting April 7
items.quote: This year probably the temperature is also likely to be hotter and better and last year probably the school holidays and other things also flashed and the holidays are just balancing out after covid now the holidays are starting by April 7 the season should be much better in my opinion

items.statement: Ice-cream likely to grow much faster in summer; curd division also expected to do better
items.quote: In fact probably ice -cream is likely to grow much faster in the summer season and also not only ice -cream probably we also have our curd division which is likely to do better in the summer

items.statement: Raw material prices now under control with enough stock to manage season
items.quote: Because actually we have got enough stock of material to just go through the season and last year before we had the raw material prices out of control and now everything is under control and we have got enough stocks to manage.

items.statement: Debt expected to reduce to 1200-1300 crores by June quarter end
items.quote: Maybe 1300 - 1200 is possible 1300 okay it comes down by so that'll be nearly 300 to 400 crores lower in comparison to the number that we last have

items.statement: Expects debt to come down to around 500 crores by June 2025
items.quote: Around 2025 June you can expect the debt to come down to five hundreds.

items.statement: Heavy investment in extruded technology and Hyderabad plant gives unique product advantage and premium pricing
items.quote: we have made heavy investments on extruded technology and the latest plant of ours in Hyderabad is able to churn out and we are also able to get a premium out of it

items.statement: Acquisition expected to add ~10% revenue growth in coming year and ~90 bps EBIT margin accretion to digital technologies business
items.quote: With this acquisition, our EBIT in digital technologies sales should grow by about 90 basis points, which is 0.9% of the EBIT with technologies business currently. In terms of revenue, this acquisition will help getting another 10% revenue growth in the coming year, so that's about the revenue and the margin.

items.statement: Total consideration $17.3M ($14.3M upfront, $3M over 2 years, up to $3.7M earnout) funded from internal accruals
items.value: $17.3M total ($14.3M upfront + $3M deferred + up to $3.7M earnout)
items.quote: We will pay a total of $17.3 million, out of which $14.3 will be upfront and $3 million will be over a period of two years. In addition to this, we will pay up to $3.7 million on achievement of certain business targets in the next two years. All these things will be from internal accruals and internal resources.

items.statement: Dextara EBIT margin ~16.5% (EBITDA ~19%), accretive to Datamatics digital technologies EBIT
items.quote: Dextara was founded in 2019 and within a span of four years, they have grown to a revenue of $7.2 million, with healthy EBIT margin of almost at 16.5%. This margin will be EBIT accretive to Datamatics.

items.statement: Salesforce market growing 20-25% worldwide, estimated $50B by 2026; 85% of Dextara revenue from US/UK
items.quote: Salesforce business is growing business and growing 20%, 25% worldwide in the last three years, market is huge. So, it is estimated to be 50 billion by 2026. So, we have a lot of opportunity in this market.

items.statement: Dextara brings proprietary products (CPQ, DXHealth+, DXTemplates) and deep expertise in Health/Service/Sales Cloud; will lead combined Salesforce practice
items.quote: they have a couple of products that they have, which is Dextara CPQ, DXHealth+ and DXTemplates. These are 3 platform products that they've built, which help s them to sell. Outside of that, they have a deep expertise in Health cloud, Service cloud, Sales cloud

items.statement: All-cash deal because management believes Datamatics stock is undervalued; no ESOP plan currently for acquired talent
items.quote: So, we still believe that Datamatics is not fairly valued in the market. So, if we did a swap, we believe we'll be selling cheap. I think Datamatics needs to have a more realistic value on the stock market, and therefore, we didn't do a swap.

items.statement: Dextara management team retained; team has experience running $1.2B/20K people operations; 20+ US-based staff
items.quote: So yes, we will retain the entire management team. When we buy services compan y, what we really have is a core team of people, and people are very critical. So yes, the agenda is to retain them. They do not have an exit

items.statement: Q3 FY24 EBITDA margin fell to 10% from 16% in Q3 FY23 due to higher retailer margin, overhead inflation, and raw material mix.
items.quote: If you compare the same numbers in Q3 of FY23 we witnessed a revenue drop of 1% and EBITDA margin lower from 16% to 10%.

items.statement: 9M FY24 EBITDA margin declined to 12% from 14% in 9M FY23 despite stable gross margin of 29%.
items.quote: Revenue from operations for 9 month we reported at INR 1,044 crores at a gross profit margin of 29% and EBITDA margin of 12%.

items.statement: Retailer margin on INR5 SKUs increased from 50 paise to 75 paise in Q2 FY24, impacting Q3 EBITDA by ~INR13 crore.
items.quote: In Q2 of FY24 we had increased the retailer margin on our INR5 SKUs on Namkeen and Gathiya products from INR 50 paisa to INR 75 paisa. This has impacted our EBITDA to close to INR13 crores for the quarter 3 of FY24.

items.statement: Palm oil prices fell 23% YoY in Q3 FY24 while chana prices rose 24% YoY; net raw material benefit of INR9.47 crore passed on via grammage increase from 20g to 25g.
items.quote: During Q3 of FY24 we have witnessed a reduction in palm oil prices to the extent of 23% versus Q3 of previous year. And increase in chana prices almost 24% versus Q3 of previous year. The net benefit is positive which we have passed on to the customer by w ay of grammage increase from 20 grammage to 25 grammage in couple of our

items.statement: Q4 FY24 demand expected similar to Q3 but better than Q4 FY23; industry seasonally strong in Feb-Mar.
items.quote: Q4 will be similar but much better than last year Q4. Overall, if you look at the industry, I think Q4 normally in the snack industry is the oxygen market particularly in the month of Feb and March.

items.statement: Targeting revenue growth above industry CAGR of 10-11%; no specific revenue or margin guidance given.
items.quote: And based on our internal efforts and estimations, we are targeting better growth than the industry.

items.statement: Long-term EBITDA margin range guided at plus/minus 2% around current levels.
items.quote: No, so margin plus minus 2% will be the range of our reporting.

items.statement: Capacity utilization below 40%; existing capacity can support 2x revenue growth without major capex for 2-3 years.
items.quote: Our capacity utilization from all the plants put together is below 40% and we have already invested in future capex and there is a potential to grow revenue by 2x without any major capex.

items.statement: INR5 SKU share declined to 69% of revenue in Q3 FY24 from 75% YoY; INR10 SKU grew ~43% YoY driven by wafers, besan, other products.
items.quote: INR5 SKU contributes 69% of our revenue which was 75% in Q3 of last year. We have witnessed a growth in INR10 SKU at least by 43% in Q3 of FY'24 versus Q3 of FY'23.

items.statement: Wafers volume grew ~35% YoY in Q3 and ~28% in 9M FY24; wafers now 9-10% of revenue, western snacks overall 31%.
items.quote: Western snacks distinctively identified potato wafers as a key growth driver bolstering a growth in terms of number of pouches sold also at 34.7%.

items.statement: Focus states (Maharashtra, MP, Rajasthan, UP) revenue grew 13% YoY in Q3 and 9% in 9M; now 24% of total revenue with 298 distributors.
items.quote: We witnessed a growth of 13% in revenue year on year from focus state in Q3 and 9% for 9 months from previous year.

items.statement: Family split in FY23 caused distributor attrition and employee turnover; ethnic snack sales in Gujarat declined 9% in 9M FY24 vs competitors' 15% growth.
items.quote: In a year back, we had this family split, where the Bipin Bhai promoter acquired the stake of his brother. And for that reason, we did the IP O also for repayment of loss. Because of the family split, and there was some internal disturbance, and we had higher attrition in terms of our employees.

items.statement: Debt reduced from INR107 crore (Mar'23) to INR26 crore (Sep'23); repaid ~INR75 crore in H1 FY24; generated INR122 crore operating cash flow in FY23.
items.quote: We believe in financial discipline and the company has judicially utilized cash towards lowering debt from INR 107 crores in March '23 to INR 26 crores as of September '23 and generated cash flow from operation of INR122 crores in FY'23.

items.statement: Exports <1% of revenue; plan to build export team and focus on exports in coming years.
items.quote: As of now, we have exports around one percent, less than one percent of our contribution.

items.statement: Retail touchpoints ~5 lakh as of Dec'23; 638 distributors (280+ exclusive in Gujarat); no super-stockist layer.
items.quote: So, total retail outlet reach has been close to 5 lakhs as of December closing.

items.statement: Minor capex for backward integration (e.g., besan unit in Nagpur, peanut processing) but no major plant capex needed for 2-3 years.
items.quote: Minor capex here and there definitely it will be required but not the major one. So, basically we require any capex for backward integration, not for the manufacturing of our plant.

items.statement: MD & CEO Chandra Shekhar Ghosh will retire on July 9, 2024, after completing his current term
items.quote: I have decided to retire from my position as Managing Director & CEO when my current term ends on July 9th, 2024.

items.statement: Ghosh will transition to a strategic role at the holding company level, not a board role at the bank
items.quote: I am transitioning to a higher strategic role at the holding company level. In my new role, I will pursue a strategic responsibility where I can leverage my experience and insights to contribute to the group's overall growth and prosperity.

items.statement: Board has a succession plan in place; interim CEO may be appointed if successor not identified by July 9
items.quote: We are planning that if within three months we do not identify a successor, in the interim period, someone internally will take the role of interim CEO until that final one will be happen.

items.statement: Selection of new CEO candidates expected to take minimum three months based on prior experience
items.quote: Whatever, our experience in the earlier selections, when we selected two executive directors on the basis of that experience we need a minimum three months of time for selection of candidates and then it will to go to RBI and then whatever is the time taken by RBI for approval

items.statement: No communication received from RBI regarding the retirement announcement
items.quote: No, no communication from RBI.

items.statement: Audit by NCGTC is ongoing and expected to conclude in about one month; no linkage to retirement decision
items.quote: the audit is still going on and it is going to take another one month or so to get concluded. We haven't heard anything from the auditor or from NCGTC in this regard. Therefore, it has absolutely no linkage with the audit.

items.statement: Ghosh holds approximately 0.5% stake in the bank as MD; family holding at holdco level is less than 2%
items.quote: As an MD, I have a stake in the bank. It is so because I was a Founder. I have some initial capital that I needed to give to the bank to start it. That is only half percent. But the holding company level, we have the holding at the family level, the stake is less than two percent.

items.statement: Senior management team including two Executive Directors and CFO joined recently and are ready to lead next growth phase
items.quote: The Bank has a very strong and capable senior management who are ready to take the bank into the next leap of growth. I am fully confident that Bandhan Bank's growth story is secure and in very safe and capable hands.

items.statement: Unexecuted order book of Rs.2,582 crores as on 31 March 2024, 72% growth vs FY23, to be executed over ~15 months
items.quote: The unexecuted order book (UOB) as on 31 March 2024 totals to Rs. 2,582 crores; 72% growth v/s FY23 to be executed over the execution cycle of approximately 15 months.

items.statement: Expect revenue of ~Rs.2,600 crores in FY25 from current order book and EBITDA margin of 12.5%-13%
items.quote: Subhadip, the current order book what we have is to be delivered in next 15 month’s time. So, we are trying to achieve that. And EBITDA marg in will remain somewhere between 12.5% to 13

items.statement: Target export revenue share of 25% by FY26-27, up from 11% in FY24
items.quote: we have been given a guidance that by FY26 we want 25% share in the export

items.statement: Order inflow guidance of Rs.1,500-2,000 crores for FY25 based on 15-20% conversion of Rs.17,000+ crore inquiry pipeline
items.quote: See, generally, if you look at our past record, the conversion has been in line of 15% to 20%. So, if INR17,000 crores of orders are in the pipeline, then anywhere between Rs.1,500 crores to Rs.2,000 crores should not be far-fetched.

items.statement: New automated plant for green hydrogen and solar transformers (20 MVA, 80-100 units/month) expected ready by December 2024; QIP proceeds partly for this expansion
items.quote: this plant expansion has already started, and we expect this plant to be ready by December 2024.

items.statement: Board approved QIP/preferential issue of Rs.500 crores for inorganic growth, capacity expansion, backward integration and working capital reduction; completion targeted by end of Q1 FY25
items.quote: Pinkesh, by end of first quarter it should be completed.

items.statement: Q4FY24 EBITDA margin 12.9% (up 576 bps YoY); FY24 EBITDA margin 10% (up 155 bps); raw material cost 72-74% of revenue; expect margins to improve with full backward integration by Dec 2025
items.quote: EBIDTA margin was at 12.9%, a sharp 576-bps increase from 7.2% in Q4FY23.

items.statement: Strong demand across renewables (solar, green hydrogen), steel, railways (Scott/V-connected transformers), data centers, and exports; inquiry pipeline Rs.17,000+ crore including overseas
items.quote: As on 31 March 2024, company has total inquiries of ₹17,000+ crore under negotiation at various stages including overseas inquiries.

items.statement: Majority of orders have price variation clauses; working capital cycle improving with monthly collections of Rs.125-130 crore in H2FY24; borrowings reducing
items.quote: Basically, the majority of the orders are on the price variable clause.

items.statement: Current capacity utilization 60-65% at 36,000-37,000 MVA; new 12,000 MVA capacity by Dec 2024; peak utilization target 85% by FY26
items.quote: Rishi, we are right now operating at around 60% to 65% levels.

items.statement: Deliberately reduced State Electricity Board exposure from 51% to 31% of revenue to improve cash flows; focusing on EPC contractors
items.quote: We have deliberately taken a decision that we would be quoting less to State Electricity Board and more to EPC contractors who are in eventual ly servicing the State Electricity Board. That helps our cash flows better

items.statement: Indian transformer market growing at ~14% CAGR per market research; company focusing on next two years growth
items.quote: Annually, if you see that market research report is that Indian transformer market is increasing by around 14% CAGR levels.

items.statement: Export inquiries limited to 15% of pipeline due to strong domestic demand; export execution cycle similar to domestic (~15 months)
items.quote: Exports would not go beyond 15% this year. Ashwani Sharma: Okay. Satyen Mamtora: Because see the local demand for our country is also so high that since this is growing exponentially, exports may not go beyond 15

items.statement: Full backward integration targeted by December 2025; currently at 40-50% backward integration; expected to improve margins from current levels
items.quote: We should be fully backward integrated by December 2025.

items.statement: Near-term demand visibility unclear and volatile; clients conserving cash and pausing discretionary projects with low immediate ROI
items.quote: The short-term demand remains very unclear or volatile. So that's a cautionary stand. Like, once we go through the quarter, probably we'll get a better understanding of the overall net demand.

items.statement: Expect FY25 to be better than FY24 based on strong TCV conversion and deal momentum
items.quote: Seeing the TCV of whatever we signed this quarter, we believe FY'25 should be better than FY'24.

items.statement: Subcontractor cost lever may have bottomed out; future margin improvement from pyramid, pricing, utilization
items.quote: We believe some of the levers, like the subcontractor cost which was one of the levers which helped significantly in FY'24, might have bottomed out. But with our focus on disciplined execution, we believe levers like pyramid, pricing and utilization can still help us.

items.statement: Incremental margins to come from structural pricing improvements across portfolio, renewals, and new deals
items.quote: We believe that incremental margins will have to be contributed by pricing improvements that need not be through an immediate pricing increase, but we will need to work out structurally.

items.statement: BFSI pent-up demand exists but near-term clients conserving cash; insurance and capital markets showing strength
items.quote: We continue to see pent-up demand in BFS, which will be a growth driver in the medium to long term, but in the near term, clients continue to conserve cash and focus on business-critical projects with immediate RoI.

items.statement: Consumer business showing green shoots with highest sequential growth in four quarters; airlines, transportation performing well
items.quote: However, we saw some green shoots and moderate growth during the quarter, which represented the highest sequential growth in the last four quarters.

items.statement: Gen AI adoption accelerating; AI.Cloud unit and Academy launched; wider adoption expected in FY25 with human-in-the-loop approach
items.quote: We expect wider adoption in financial year 2025, with focus on seamless integration with current workflows with a human-in-the-loop approach.

items.statement: BSNL deal ramping across 100,000 towers; 10,000 installed so far; 5G upgrades and maintenance to provide future revenue streams
items.quote: We are focusing on installing the network across 100,000 towers. We have achieved about 10,000 towers as of date, and there are further opportunities. For example, beyond rolling out these 100,000 towers, we also have to upgrade a good number of them to 5G.

items.statement: Deal mix 55-60% cost optimization, remainder transformational; vendor consolidation and operating model transformation key themes
items.quote: I would say maybe 55 to 60% in terms of cost and optimization and the remaining in terms of transformative engagement.

items.statement: Client metrics expanded across all bands: $100M+ clients at 62, $50M+ at 139, $20M+ at 301, $10M+ at 487, $5M+ at 693, $1M+ at 1,294
items.quote: In Q4, we added 2 more clients year-on-year in the $100 million+ band bringing the total to 62. 6 more clients in the $50 million+ band bringing the total to 139. 10 more clients in the $20 million+ band bringing the total to 301.

items.statement: LTM IT services attrition fell to 12.5%, down 80 bps sequentially, within comfort range of 11-13%
items.quote: Our LTM attrition in IT services kept trending down throughout the year and was at 12.5% at the end of Q4, down 80 bps sequentially and in our comfort range of 11% to 13%.

items.statement: Announced salary increments effective April 1 similar to prior years; top performers receiving double-digit hikes
items.quote: As we have done consistently every year, we have announced a salary increment for all of our employees with effects on April 1st, similar in quantum to prior years, with top performers receiving double digit hikes.

items.statement: Revenue CAGR of 17% and EBITDA CAGR of 7-8% historically; targeting operating margin of 26-27% in FY25
items.quote: we are growing up at the 17% of C AGR in the revenue side and EBITDA growth is a bit down because earlier we were growing at 12% to 13% now it is at 7% to 8% CAGR this

items.statement: Expecting 20% top-line growth in FY25
items.quote: Yes. If we talk about the operational margin as I said that it is going to be between 24% to 26%.

items.statement: Operating EBITDA margin maintained at 24-26% range; consolidated EBITDA margin 15.7% in FY24
items.quote: we are doing at 24% of operating margin whic h is given in the presentation - which is net of what we pay to the broadc asters and net of one time revenue and

items.statement: Targeting operating margin of 25-26% in FY25; consolidated margin expected at 17-18%
items.quote: we are confident that we will be back to 25% to 26% next year.

items.statement: Capex guidance of Rs 350-400 crore for FY25
items.quote: We are going to do CAPEX of between 350 crores to 400 crores in FY25.

items.statement: India wired broadband subscribers at 38.9 million (12% penetration); industry expected to reach 150 million in 5-7 years
items.quote: We are considering that somewhere the wire broadband from 38 million, 39 million will go to around 150 million i n next 5 years to 7 years

items.statement: Broadband subscriber additions of 100K-150K per year; targeting 1.2-1.5 million subscribers in 3 years
items.quote: We are going to add between 100K to 150 K every year and we will reach somewhere around in the next 3 years somewhere between 1.2 to 1.5 million

items.statement: BharatNet Phase 1&2 project of Rs 46 crore for 8,000 Gujarat villages nearing completion; 12% margin
items.quote: this project is granted by Gujarat ISP Private Limited GISL after tendering of Rs. 46 crores wherein the Gram Panchayat of 8000 Gujarat villages under phase one and phase two of BharatN et project has to be made Wi -Fi enabled

items.statement: Convergence strategy bundling Cable TV, broadband, OTT, gaming and TV everywhere to improve stickiness and ARPU
items.quote: The overarching strategy involves convergence of both Cable TV and broadband services to provide holistic bundles to our subscribers to fulfill their en tertainment and connectivity need

items.statement: Broadband ARPU stable at Rs 460; focusing on volume growth not price hikes in competitive market
items.quote: broadband is the volume game right now not the v alue game. We are maintaining our ARPU in this competitive market and we will try to do that to main tain our ARPU throughout

items.statement: CATV churn rate of 15-17% annually; activation revenue declining as deferred revenue unwinds
items.quote: churn is between 15% to 17% varying here and there with the market between 15% to 17% is the churn which is going on

items.statement: Dividend of 40% (Rs 4 per share) recommended for FY24
items.quote: For current Financial Year FY24 Board of Directors have recommended dividend of 40% - Rs. 4 per share.

items.statement: Metro Cast acquisition consolidated from Q2 FY24; added 4.5 lakh subscribers; stake increased to 50.1% in Q4
items.quote: Yes, it's like 4.4 to 4.5 lakhs which is there in 9.5 million which we have given. So, 4.5 lakh subscriber has come from the Metro Cast.

items.statement: GTPL Genie app relaunch by end of April or first week of May; 75K current users; ARPU Rs 119-300 with 18-20% margin
items.quote: it will be launched by the end of April or first week of May somewhere. So, already app has gone into the UAT with the user testing

items.statement: Borrowings increased due to project margin money and OD utilization; expected to normalize to FY23 levels in FY25
items.quote: by FY25 which will be at the same level as it was in FY23. In FY24 it has been increased because of the projects

items.statement: FY25 mined metal production guidance 1,100-1,125 kt, refined metal 1,075-1,100 kt, saleable silver 750-775 tons
items.value: 1,100-1,125 kt mined; 1,075-1,100 kt refined; 750-775 tons silver
items.quote: Our FY'25 guidance for mined metal production is set at 1,100 to 1,125 kt, refined metal production at 1,075 to 1,100 kt and saleable silver production of 750 to 775 tons.

items.statement: FY25 zinc cost of production guidance $1,050-1,100 per ton
items.quote: we are geared towards pursuing our guidance of cost $1,050 to $1,100 per ton for FY'25

items.statement: FY25 growth capex $270-335 million for roaster, fertilizer, RE power and debottlenecking
items.quote: growth capex of $270 to $335 million which will be mostly for roaster, fertilizer, RE power and de bottlenecking

items.statement: Operating pyro plants in zinc-lead mode instead of lead-only mode, reducing lead and attached silver output
items.quote: As of now, our strategy is to operate on zinc plus lead mode and hence the metal numbers are as high as you are looking at and corresponding growth in silver is not visible.

items.statement: Domestic zinc consumption grew 20% YoY and forecasted to stay strong in line with steel market
items.quote: The domestic zinc consumption has grown by 20% year-on-year on the back of stronger PMI and is forecasted to stay strong in line with the steel market.

items.statement: Maintained industry-leading 47% EBITDA margin despite 25% YoY fall in zinc prices
items.quote: despite the 25% y-o-y fall in zinc prices, we successfully maintain our industry-leading margin of 47%

items.statement: Bamnia Kalan mine has 1 million ton resource, 700 tons silver, annual revenue potential 1,000+ crores at current LME
items.quote: Bamnia Kalan mine has almost 1 million ton of the resource in the metal terms, and 700 tons of kind of the silver. Annual potential revenue at current LME is 1,000 crores plus

items.statement: Refined metal capacity currently 1.123 mtpa, debottlenecking to 1.25 mtpa in 12-16 months, targeting 2 mtpa in 2.5-3 years
items.value: 1.123 mtpa current; 1.25 mtpa target; 2 mtpa vision
items.quote: We said 1.123 currently and we are launching a lot of debottlenecking projects to take it to 1.25 million ton s, but safely speaking, it will be about 1.2 million tons in about 12 to 14 months or maybe 16 months

items.statement: Mining lease renewals for Agucha and Zawar (65% of output) due 2030; profitability impact uncertain but management expects to maintain current levels
items.quote: Agucha and Zawar will be put together 65%. But in terms of profitability point of view, 50%, given that SK is the silver-rich mine.

items.statement: Zinc price outlook: breach $3,000/t by Aug-Sep, reach $3,200/t by Dec 2024; concentrate market tight with TC/RC at $75 spot vs $165 benchmark
items.quote: Maybe somewhere closer to August or September, we will bridge the mark of $3,000. By December, I'm very hopeful that we will be closer to the mark of $3,200 or so.

items.statement: Renewable energy power delivery agreement accelerated, first power flow expected April 2024
items.quote: I am pleased to share that our renewable energy power delivery agreement is also progressing well and has been accelerated with first flow of power expected this month.

items.statement: Gross reserves Rs 10,384 crore, total reserves including RE Rs 15,000 crore; GR to RE conversion hearing 17 May 2024
items.value: Rs 10,384 crore GR; Rs 15,000 crore total
items.quote: So, GR is basically Rs.10,384 crores and including GR and RE, it's a Rs.15,000 crores.

items.statement: Aspiring for 15% plus top-line growth in FY25
items.quote: But as I mentioned, endeavor is that overall year should have about 15% plus growth in top line, and that is what we are aspiring for.

items.statement: Targeting 8-9% annual paid campaign growth
items.quote: Our endeavor is to grow campaigns by 8% to 9% on overall annual basis.

items.statement: Exited Q4 FY24 at 26.1% EBITDA margin with room for further expansion
items.quote: In terms of margins, we had robust 26.1% EBITDA margin for the quarter, which represented 334 basis points sequential improvement and about 11.8 percentage points on a year-on-year basis.

items.statement: Expect FY25 effective tax rate close to or less than 10% due to treasury reclassification
items.quote: FY'25 could be even close to or less than 10% overall.

items.statement: Long-term advertising spend target of 5-6% of revenue
items.quote: Long term, we would think that this business definitely needs 5% to 6% of top line going into advertising on a sustainable basis.

items.statement: Price hikes continuous; half of revenue growth targeted from pricing
items.quote: Overall target is that out of my 15%, 16% or whatever revenue growth materializes, half of it should materialize from volume growth and rest half of it from pricing increase.

items.statement: Tier 2/3 ARPU at ~INR1,100/month vs blended INR1,540; significant pricing headroom
items.quote: Against INR 1,540 a month of my blended realization, my Tier 2, Tier 3 is only at about INR1,100, which is what lends this tailwind that there can be significant price increases in these cities as well.

items.statement: SMEs have greater realization of need for online presence post-COVID; subscription highly affordable
items.quote: Our assessment is that post COVID, SMEs have a far greater realization that they need to be present on an online platform such as Just Dial so that they can get discovered and they can get new comers.

items.statement: Monthly plans now 56-57% of active campaigns; perpetual auto-renewal reducing churn
items.quote: So 56%, 57% are on monthly plans right now.

items.statement: B2B campaigns ~22% of volume with 10-15% higher ticket size vs B2C
items.quote: Volume-wise, campaign-wise contribution of B2B would be around 22-odd percent or so.

items.statement: Jio integration progress slower; not expecting meaningful traffic contribution currently
items.quote: Having said that, at this point of time, one might say that this progress has been relatively slower, but that is because that we don't e xpect or we are not building in meaningful traffic contribution from these sources at this point of time

items.statement: Cash and investments INR4,625 crores yielding 7.2% pre-tax; no concrete deployment/distribution decision
items.quote: So Lavanya, the cash balance of INR4,625 crores, so righ t now, and is yielding 7.2% pre -tax for us. And at this point of time, there is no concrete decision on either deployment or distribution of this

items.statement: Headcount 12,800; open to adding 4-5% workforce in productive geographies
items.quote: We are keeping options open of adding, say, 4%, 5% workforce in the coming year because the fact is that in our country, SMEs still need a great amount of handholding.

items.statement: Deferred revenue INR508 crores, 90% current component to accrue as revenue in FY25
items.quote: Firstly, the deferred revenue that we had at the end of the year was about INR508 crores, out of which almost 90% would be sort of a current component, which will get accrued as revenue during the year as services are rendered.

items.quote: we have guided to 31% embedded EBITDA margin for Fiscal '25 compared to 30% for Fiscal '24

items.statement: Average price growth of approximately 5.5% for FY24
items.quote: In terms of pricing, in line with our guidance, we had an overall average price growth of approximately 5.5% for Fiscal '24.

items.statement: Pune pre-sales grew to Rs.1,800+ crores in FY24 from Rs.1,100 crores in FY23
items.quote: Pune now has grown to sales of about 1,800-plus crores compared to 1,100 crores in Fiscal '23

items.statement: Targeting at least 30% growth in Palava and Upper Thane pre-sales in FY25 from Rs.2,200 crores base
items.quote: about 2,200 crores of pre-sales for Fiscal ‘24. We definitely expect that to grow much faster than the rest of the Company, because the infrastructure-related upgrades are now largely in place. So, we would be looking for at least 30% growth, if not more in this fiscal

items.statement: Operating cash flow guidance of Rs.65 billion for FY25 vs Rs.57 billion in FY24
items.quote: we generated 57 billion of operating cash for Fiscal '24 and are guiding to about 65 billion for Fiscal '25

items.statement: Geopolitical tensions remain a pervasive risk that can impact sentiment and macroeconomic indicators
items.quote: the global situation has been full of various challenges, including geopolitical tensions. This is a risk which is pervasive and in front of our eyes and from time-to-time it is definitely likely to have Macrotech Developers Limited April 25, 2024 impact on the overall sentiment as well as the direction of several macroeconomic indicators

items.statement: QIP capital raised in March will be deployed over next 6-12 months for growth and bottom line improvement
items.quote: we have raised a meaningful amount of capital towards the end of the last fiscal in March and that capital will become growth fuel for us both for improvement of the bottom line as well as for strengthening our growth prospects as we invest that capital over the next six to 12 months.

items.statement: Added Rs.20,000 crores GDV through new projects in FY24, exceeding guidance of Rs.17,500 crores
items.quote: In terms of our business development, we added about 20,000 crores of GDV through new projects, which was higher than our guidance of 17,500 crores.
